name: IID Univariate Benchmark
description: A benchmark suite of i.i.d. univariate time series tasks for evaluating forecasting methods.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE / MAPE (common forecasting error metrics)
reputation: A recognized controlled i.i.d. testbed in the forecasting literature for method comparison, though less prominent than large heterogeneous real‑world benchmarks.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark; focuses on i.i.d. univariate series which may not reflect real-world temporal dependencies. Results are dataset‑ and scale‑dependent; evaluation sensitive to preprocessing and split protocols.
